Auf der Kommandozeile: uwulock-server bl: On the command line: uwulock-server blocks lists the blocks, uwulock-server blocks remove <address> lifts one – also when you shut yourself out.
Ausgeschaltet lädt der Server nichts her: Switched off, the server downloads nothing, shows no origin and deletes the database in its next nightly run.
Das ist deine eigene Adresse – du würdes: This is your own address – you would shut yourself out.
Der Download läuft; das dauert ein, zwei: The download is running; it takes a minute or two.
Eine Adresse, oder ein Netz wie 203.0.11: One address, or a network like 203.0.113.0/24 or 2001:db8::/64.
Jede abgelehnte Anmeldung der letzten 90: Every refused login of the last 90 days: where it came from, with which device and app, and for which account. An address that tries a lot can be blocked.
Keine abgelehnten Anmeldungen in diesem: No refused logins in this period.
Land, Stadt und Netz einer Adresse komme: Country, city and network of an address come from a database on this server. The server downloads it from DB-IP once a month; no single address is ever looked up elsewhere.
Von diesen Adressen geht keine Anmeldung: No login works from these addresses until the block runs out or you lift it – no registration and no password hints either. Your address right now: {ip}.
Von dieser Adresse geht dann keine Anmel: No login will work from this address any more: not in the web vault, not in the admin portal, not in the apps. Whoever is logged in already stays logged in.
Wie sich Konten anmelden, wie stark Mast: How accounts log in, how strong master passwords must be, who gets into the admin portal, and who tries in vain.
